title: Auth gate strategy: app-level vs RLS
essence: Enforce access control via Next.js app-level auth gating, not Supabase RLS, while ARCS is single-user; RLS only when multi-tenant.

title: SQLite dev / Supabase prod split
essence: SQLite local fallback, Supabase Postgres prod; Prisma 7 forces url/directUrl into prisma.config.ts, root cause of 6 Vercel build failures.

title: COCD as first-class UX primitive
essence: Surface Calibrate-Orient-Chart-Detect loop as the primary UX frame on arcs.care, supplementing the 10x-lighter hero.

title: Wire mcp.arcs.care to perplexity-mcp
essence: Fix mcp.arcs.care 404 by adding the custom subdomain to the perplexity-mcp Vercel project and CNAME at registrar.

title: Vercel-Supabase env var injection
essence: Canonical DATABASE_URL reaches arcs-v9 via Vercel-Supabase integration prefix DATABASE (was mis-set to STORAGE); execution diverged to manual set.

title: Supabase branching for previews
essence: Defer isolated per-PR Supabase branch DBs until first external contributor PR or first prod receipt exists; risk surface currently zero.

title: db push vs migrate deploy
essence: Use db push during bootstrap, switch to tracked migrate deploy on first post-launch schema change once a real user exists; never mix the two.

title: RLS deny-all for non-superuser roles
essence: Enable RLS with explicit deny-all for anon/authenticated on all 9 tables; auth.uid() policies wrong because Prisma superuser bypasses RLS and auth.uid() is always NULL.

title: Canonical inline-style component library
essence: Build src/ui canonical inline-style Badge/Button/Card recovered from arcs-app git history (commit 83374ed), extended from arcs-v9 tokens.

title: Rename arcs-dewy to fix module shadowing
essence: Flat arcs_dewy.py shadows the arcs-dewy/ package, forcing _HAS_DEWY=False and killing live ReceiptObject construction; rename to resolve.

title: Direct vs barrel UI imports
essence: Import UI components directly from files rather than a barrel index.ts, avoiding Turbopack re-export resolution cost until component count grows.

title: arcs.care PLG phase 1
essence: Swap the model powering the live arcs.care compass and surface a Lab offer card post-result to maximize free-to-paid conversion.

title: Founding-10 conversion build sequence
essence: arcs.care serves warm referrals not cold PLG, so hero redesign is third-order; prioritize email capture + case-study receipt excerpt + spots badge.

title: NOTOMATION circuit breaker CI/CD
essence: Set an automation authority ceiling for arcs-care CI/CD enforcing NOTOMATION (ROM #1) while still allowing automated build-failure repair.

title: Case-study content dependency gate
essence: Absence of a shareable founding-client outcome blocks only the case-study excerpt; email capture and spots badge proceed independently.

title: Anonymous vs authenticated compass
essence: Let arcs-v9 compass run anonymously (Receipt.userId nullable) with optional account creation as a post-session prompt, not a 401 gate.

title: receipt-core canonical schema
essence: Define one canonical receipt field set (dewy-receipt-schema-v1.json) so arcs.care Supabase and arcs-v9 Prisma cannot drift; permanent write-lock surface.

title: /helpful raw-paste vs structured form
essence: Consider replacing arcs.care/helpful 5-field form with a single raw-context paste field, delegating structure extraction to the engine; held pending architect packet.

title: ReceiptObject as wire/storage type
essence: Keep Pydantic ReceiptObject (arcs_dewy) as the wire/storage format only; DecisionReceipt/CoherenceReceipt stay the internal operator runtime types.

title: Tribune Intelligence Layer
essence: Wrap the receipt flow with a three-phase annotation system (Anterior premortem / Proactive silent kinematic / Posterior) without modifying the sealed ReceiptObject.

title: DEWY receipt schema prose companion
essence: A Receipt is a state vector frozen at L0-L5 PASS; DEWY = Decision/Entity/Window/YellowGate; HOLD/REJECT produce stub receipts only.

title: DEWY receipt JSON Schema (machine authority)
essence: Machine-readable canonical JSON Schema for the DEWY receipt; the enforcement authority when prose companion conflicts.

title: Receipt type registry
essence: Registry enumerating the canonical receipt types/variants recognized across the ARCS runtime.

title: Question Compass to DEWY flow
essence: End-to-end flow mapping a Question Compass input through L0-L5 to a persisted DEWY receipt.

title: Decision Receipt Schema v1.1
essence: Earlier v1.1 field-OS decision receipt schema with on-purpose/on-accident fields, NCI grading, and Kintsugi metadata.

title: ARCS v9 ROM starter axioms
essence: Six non-negotiable execution laws: Clarity-before-Curvature, Agency-over-Automation, Minimum-Steps-to-Coherence, Kairos-over-Neuroticism, Drift-Sentinel-Required, Stable-True-North across clarity modes.

title: Time Quality Attribution ROM
essence: Constitutional ROM primitives for W-field window inference, time-quality degradation, and cadence NCI lens scoring; never override at runtime.

title: HOLD/REJECT validation gate
essence: Three-state guard (PASS/HOLD/REJECT) running before any invocation: normalize-and-execute, surface one anticipatory probe, or hard-stop with failure receipt.

title: Funhouse Optics Rule (6th always-on ROM candidate)
essence: Master spec lists a sixth always-on ROM candidate beyond the canonical five: Funhouse Optics Rule, plus Triune Logic and Diamond Protocol layers.

title: Triune Logic epistemic kernel
essence: v8.4 epistemic kernel: three-valued logic NULL / OM / UNDEFINED enforcing epistemic honesty; not-yet-legible and no-input are valid high-status states.

title: v9 canon ROM primitives table
essence: Field-tested ROM primitives: Write-Lock/Commitment-Ordering, RAM-vs-ROM protocol, Kintsugi/NCI, Kinematic Manifold Plie (yield) / Eleve (flow superionic) as executive motion.

title: Tolma / Prosopon / Loki gauge system
essence: The emotional dimension Munger omitted: three gauges — Tolma (self-worth claim accuracy), Prosopon gap (mask-inner delta), Loki sensitivity (adversarial self-test rate).

title: Bidirectional humane boundary
essence: Munger's circle guards outward against overreach; the extension guards inward against collapse under the weight of depth — the mikropsychia trap and self-erasure.

title: Bias as golden seam, not failure
essence: A surfaced bias is a receipt, not a failure — the system working. Detects ego traps, midcurving, authority deference, commitment bias, incentive distortion.

title: Five Munger design primitives
essence: Boundary-first, inversion-before-action, latticework-over-single-model, misjudgment-defense, compounding-via-patience — NULL/OM/UNDEFINED are valid high-status outputs.

title: One question, auto-inferred stakes
essence: The single input 'What are you really trying to decide?' is a pressure test revealing proxy-vs-real question; Horizon x Stakes matrix auto-infers QUICKMOVE/PLAN/COURT.

title: Sprint model as neurological rescue
essence: 20 applications in 30 minutes is neurological rescue not productivity: ~40 dopamine hits per sprint break freeze states and restore prefrontal engagement.

title: On-purpose/on-accident + dumb-luck corollary
essence: Intuition is allowed; worship is not. A hunch's outcome stays low-weight until you log why; ARCS only promotes intuition to code once written down and field-tested.

title: Append-only belief-change audit trail
essence: One entry per session tracking RESOLVED/BELIEF_CHANGE/NEW/OPEN — e.g. canonical v9 surface shifted off stale arcs-decision-receipts; True North is now live LLM not template.

title: Expected-vs-actual learnings ledger
essence: Promote RAM to ROM only when a pattern held across >=1 real run, changes runtime behavior paired with a schema field/enum/test, and an ADR records the why.

title: Earn abstractions before naming; Diamond Protocol
essence: Under Kairos Lock every abstraction is earned before named with a worked example in-section; Diamond Protocol runs NULL/OM/UNDEFINED at every boundary and HOLD/REJECT at every gate.

title: Anticipatory Tributary Generator
essence: Secondary output head on every compass response surfacing 2-4 ranked tributary chips: the meta-question, the need-to-hear branch, an adjacent implicated primitive.

title: ARCS agent fleet taxonomy
essence: Microservice agent fleet with stable roles: SAGE navigator, HELM entropy HUD, LOKI adversary, WARD risk defender — each with philosophy and L0-L5 depth params.
